description: The ecosystem's shared error classes (docs/specs/error-taxonomy.md, ADR-027, decision D41). `classes` says what each class means, whether a caller may retry it and how its message to a person is written. `codes` maps every error code a Skill contract declares today to one class; `kinds` does the same for the lower-case failure kinds of the ffmpeg-skill family (ffmpeg-skill, hyperframes-skill, remotion-ffmpeg-skill, blender-skill, imagemagick-skill, artifacts-skill). `overrides` holds a code that means something else in one Skill. scripts/error_taxonomy.py reports a code found in no table.

retry_policies.never: Do not retry. The same request fails the same way until something named in the error changes.
retry_policies.after_change: Do not retry now. Retry only after the person or the environment changed what the error names (installed a tool, freed space, gave a consent record).
retry_policies.later: Do not retry in this run. Retry after the wait the error states (details.retry_after, a quota reset), or the next day.
retry_policies.once: Retry at most once with the same arguments, and only when the Skill's own `retryable` is true.
retry_policies.once_longer: Retry at most once with a longer time limit (the agent doubles it).

INVALID_REQUEST.meaning: The request breaks the contract: a missing or wrong argument, a bad time range, a path outside the allowed roots, an output that would overwrite an input or already exists.
INVALID_REQUEST.user_message: Name the argument and what is wrong with it. When the agent built the request, say it is the agent's fault and do not ask the person to fix arguments they never typed.

INPUT_NOT_FOUND.meaning: A file, folder, manifest or cache entry the request names does not exist.
INPUT_NOT_FOUND.user_message: Name the missing file by its path and ask the person to check it is there and readable.

INVALID_INPUT.meaning: The input exists but cannot be used: corrupt, wrong type, unreadable, encrypted, or a document (timeline, transcript, plan, deck) that fails its schema.
INVALID_INPUT.user_message: Name the file and the reason (details.reason), and say what would make it usable (re-export, another format).

UNSUPPORTED.meaning: The Skill does not offer this operation, format, platform or combination, or the target format cannot carry the content.
UNSUPPORTED.user_message: Say what is not supported and, when the error names one, the alternative. Never present it as a fault of the person's file.

DEPENDENCY_MISSING.meaning: A tool, engine, model, language pack, credential store or sibling Skill the operation needs is not installed or cannot be reached on this machine.
DEPENDENCY_MISSING.user_message: Name what is missing and how to install or enable it (the Skill's doctor command when it has one).

ACTION_REQUIRED.meaning: A person must do something first: give consent, confirm, accept a licence or terms, sign in.
ACTION_REQUIRED.user_message: Say exactly what the person must provide or confirm. The agent never makes, signs or guesses it.

RESOURCE_LIMIT.meaning: The machine or the request's budget is too small: GPU memory, disk space, a page or size limit, an analysis budget.
RESOURCE_LIMIT.user_message: Name the limit, the amount needed and the amount available, and what to change (a smaller model, more space, fewer pages).

RATE_LIMITED.meaning: A remote service refused for now: an API quota or a daily or weekly upload limit. Nothing was done.
RATE_LIMITED.user_message: Say that nothing was uploaded or changed, which limit was reached and when it resets, if the error says.

TRANSIENT.meaning: A temporary fault that the same request can get past: a network fetch, an interrupted upload, a source that changed or vanished while it was copied, a copy that did not verify.
TRANSIENT.user_message: Say it is being retried. If the retry fails too, show the error as it is.

TIMEOUT.meaning: The operation ran out of time and was stopped.
TIMEOUT.user_message: Say it took too long and is being retried with more time; if that fails, suggest a shorter input or a faster setting.

CANCELLED.meaning: A person or the system stopped the run (a signal, an interrupt). It is not a timeout.
CANCELLED.user_message: Say the run was stopped and nothing more was done; the person re-runs it when they want.

ENGINE_FAILED.meaning: The engine (FFmpeg, a model, a renderer, a remote service) ran and failed, or refused the content.
ENGINE_FAILED.user_message: Give the engine's own message, shortened, and the step that failed. A remote rejection names the service.

OUTPUT_FAILED.meaning: The result could not be written or delivered whole: a write error, a partial upload.
OUTPUT_FAILED.user_message: Name where the output was to go and what is left there (a partial file, a partial upload).

VERIFICATION_FAILED.meaning: The Skill produced a result and its own check of it failed, or the result does not match its schema or its promise.
VERIFICATION_FAILED.user_message: Say what was checked and what was measured; never present the result as delivered.

INTERNAL.user_message: Say it is a fault in the Skill (name it and its version) and give the error code, so it can be reported.
